description.value: Surrey Indian Bites is a family-run Indian fast-food restaurant operating in the Central City Mall Food Court in Surrey, offering a rotating daily buffet alongside an à la carte menu of street food, curries, biryanis, and traditional breakfast dishes. The restaurant was founded by a family with deep roots in India's regional cuisines, emphasizing fresh ingredients and authentic spices passed down through generations. Touring cyclists stopping in Surrey will find a wide range of hearty options, including an extensive selection of vegetarian dishes.
